title: Meridian
subtitle: A yellow center ringed in white, throwing a sunburst of baguettes outward.

stone.origin: This exceptional pendant centers a fancy intense yellow round brilliant diamond, set in yellow gold prongs and encircled by a close-set halo of colorless round diamonds. Radiating outward, a full ring of tapered baguettes forms a sunburst around the center.

metal: yellow gold prongs and encircled by a close-set halo of color
description: A Fancy Intense Yellow round brilliant sits at the centre, ringed close in colourless diamond so the white light sharpens the warmth of the yellow. Around that, a full turn of tapered baguettes opens outward like a sunburst, each one angled to carry the eye away from the centre and then back to it. The frame is elaborate for a single reason — to hold and amplify the yellow, never to compete with it. Set in yellow gold prongs, it reads as one small sun at the throat.
